qualification_execution_interpretation: Collect Q evidence using existing merged engine interfaces. This does not declare the unresolved launch/acceptance gates passed or authorize dispatch into A/B/C/D.
clean_pause_qualification: Use existing --stop-after at multiples of 16 completed fits for every native Q slot. Verify committed prefix preservation and closed invocation clocks at every boundary. The original cumulative 1500-second budget remains binding. Chunk overhead is included and these timings must not be compared as uninterrupted production speed.
contenders_pause: Finish the active bounded slot; do not interrupt or automatically replace incomplete Contenders.
remaining_gates: Request-driven fit-boundary stopping, profiling reconciliation/equivalence, breadth adequacy, policy-aware analysis, and measured-training budget support remain unaccepted. Q cannot auto-advance. Infrastructure changes require a reviewed merged producer and requalification before scientific stages.
historical_protocol: Preserved byte-for-byte; this separate execution receipt records the user start instruction and qualification boundary behavior.
hard_failure: Retain evidence and stop. No silent replacement, removed baseline, clock rewrite or automatic source repair.
